extraction_notes: Family datasheet MMSZ5221B-MMSZ5267B; the MMSZ5242B row (type code H2) on page 2 supplies the per-part limits: VZ 11.40/12.0/12.60 V at IZT = 20 mA, ZZT(max) 30 ohm, IR(max) 1.0 uA at VR = 9.1 V.
Nominal VZ is recorded as breakdown_voltage with source_kind 'typical' because the schema has no 'nominal' kind; the min/max limits are preserved in the conditions string.

Maximum zener impedance ZZT = 30 ohm for MMSZ5242B is stated in a column headed 'ZZT@IZT=0.25mA' (pages 2-3); this header conflicts with industry-standard MMSZ5242B sheets, which specify ZZT = 30 ohm at IZT = 20 mA and ZZK = 600 ohm at 0.25 mA. The value is not schema-mappable and is noted here only.
Forward voltage 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA comes from the Maximum Ratings table on page 1 and is a maximum limit, not a typical operating point.

Capacitance is null: Fig. 5 (page 4) is a generic capacitance-vs-nominal-VZ family curve with no tabulated value for the 12 V part; reading a single-part value from the log-log family plot would not be reliable evidence.
Reverse recovery is null: not specified anywhere in the datasheet (normal for a zener reference/clamp part).
No SPICE or vendor model content used; all values transcribed from the public datasheet PDF (SHA-256 fec00843f279bccf78d55a456b749bf49d99676181d710880c28c93d8ee35181).
extraction.omission_reason: Curves omitted: Figs 1-2 (zener I-V) plot the whole MMSZ52xxB family as dozens of closely spaced unlabeled-between-gridline traces on log-current axes, and Figs 3-6 are family-level curves indexed by nominal VZ rather than per-part characteristics; the specific 12 V (MMSZ5242B) trace cannot be isolated and digitized to at least 3 trustworthy points from this raster, so no curve points were fabricated.
